summary: Anthropic announced a partnership with UST to integrate Claude and Claude Code into UST's engineering platforms for chip validation, healthcare, telecom, and banking workflows, and to train 20,000 UST employees on Claude.

mechanisms.reason: A large enterprise partner is committing to broad internal deployment of Claude across tens of thousands of employees and multiple production platforms, increasing aggregate usage.
mechanisms.quote: UST is committing to train 20,000 of its associates on Claude worldwide, including engineers, architects, consultants, industry specialists, and forward-deployed engineers, who sit alongside client teams.
